item.title: Georgia Senate Republicans approve lower income taxes as their answer to affordability
item.description: The Republican-led state Senate adopted an historic income tax cut plan Thursday that Democrats decried as an election year ploy that would undermine the state budget. item.title: Augusta agenda heavy on consent votes, including Weed Street, change orders
item.description: The Augusta Commission meeting is expected to pass quickly Tuesday with all items going for approval by consent, meaning none will be discussed unless a commissioner pulls one from the consent agenda. item.title: Grovetown police chief responds to viral video, surge of vulgar messages and legal threats
